title: Startup steps to the main procedure
statement: Let $P$ be a light program, let $p_0$ be a procedure index, let $d$ be a Boolean flag, and let $W$ be a word size. Suppose the integer $-1$ satisfies $-2^W \le 2(-1) < 2^W$, and let $m$ be any initial word-RAM memory. Executing the compiled program for $\mathrm{dispPos}(P,d)+\mathrm{frameSize}(P)+9$ steps from program counter $0$ and memory $m$ reaches program counter $\mathrm{mainPos}$ with memory given by applying the startup initialization to $m$.
hypotheses_covered: An arbitrary initial word-RAM memory m
